scope: Eight previously exposed development clips; no fresh validation, no app integration.

classification_definitions.acceptable: No material content error observed; accepted punctuation, contraction or spelling conventions may differ.
classification_definitions.minor_issue: A limited word, spelling, grammar or precision problem needs correction while the central proposition remains recoverable.
classification_definitions.major_error: A proper name, proposition, semantic relationship or substantial content is incorrectly recognized.
classification_definitions.not_evaluable: No completed aligned transcript is available.

review_method: Review exact raw hypotheses against every original reference and criterion; names, numbers, negation and meaning are not replaced by WER. No human-listening claim.

cases.reference: Κάποια φεστιβάλ παρέχουν ειδικούς κατασκηνωτικούς χώρους για οικογένειες με μικρά παιδιά.
review_criteria: Preserve the provision of special family camping areas and the reference to young children.

cases.reference: Είναι το πέμπτο προσωρινό εκλογικό συμβούλιο του Μαρτελί μέσα σε τέσσερα χρόνια.
review_criteria: Preserve the fifth council, the four-year interval and the proper name Μαρτελί. Written-out versus numeric forms may be equivalent.

cases.reference: Αυτό δεν μου βγάζει νόημα. Σε κάθε περίπτωση δεν ήταν δίκαιο.
review_criteria: Both negative statements must survive: it does not make sense, and in any case it was not fair.

cases.reference: Μολονότι 3 άνθρωποι βρίσκονταν μέσα στο σπίτι κατά την πρόσκρουση του αυτοκινήτου, δεν τραυματίστηκε κανείς.
review_criteria: Preserve the count of three people and the claim that nobody was injured despite the collision.

cases.reference: Η κύρια τοπική μπίρα ονομάζεται «Number One» και δεν αποτελεί μια σύνθετη μπύρα, είναι όμως ευχάριστη και δροσιστική. Η άλλη τοπική μπίρα λέγεται «Manta».
review_criteria: Preserve the two product names Number One and Manta and the negated description of the first beer.

cases.reference: When you call someone who is thousands of miles away, you are using a satellite.
review_criteria: Preserve the distant phone-call condition and satellite claim as spoken; this is transcription fidelity, not fact checking.

cases.reference: The U.N. also hopes to finalize a fund to help countries affected by global warming to cope with the impacts.
review_criteria: Preserve the U.N. attribution, proposed fund, affected countries and intended help in coping with warming impacts.

cases.reference: Then, Lakkha Singh took the lead in singing the bhajans.
review_criteria: Preserve the person name Lakkha Singh, leading role and the sung bhajans.
